verdict.rationale: three.js is a code-first JavaScript library: scenes, cameras, geometry, renderers, loaders and controls are all driven programmatically, and coding agents use the library directly through npm. A UI exists (the three.js editor), but no evidence documents that every editor action has an API equivalent or that parity is maintained, so parity is implied by the library's API-first nature rather than shown. missing for 10: documented editor-to-API parity mapping, programmatic access to editor-specific workflows (e.g. project save/export), independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
